freshProductionExchange.oneCToSite: counterparty name changed and restored; both site states verified

mvpOpen.finding: No separate actual applicant/contact in the dispatcher form; technical source_channel exists but is not a complete manual registration process. Archive searches createdBy, which is the registering user.
mvpOpen.exitCriterion: Dispatcher records another applicant, contact and channel while author stays in audit; archive finds that applicant.

mvpOpen.finding: Creation UI lacks explicit leaseId selection. Tenant API safely rejects ambiguous leases; staff client picks first nonterminated lease to infer tenantId.
mvpOpen.exitCriterion: Explicitly select the allowed contract/account when more than one applies; wrong and expired contexts are rejected.

mvpOpen.finding: In-app/email notification infrastructure exists; workflow decisions, reading reviews and maintenance changes do not cover the complete agreed event/recipient delivery matrix.
mvpOpen.exitCriterion: Event/recipient/channel/deep-link matrix is implemented with scope checks, deduplication and retry.

mvpOpen.finding: Two product projects and historical debug APKs exist. Four signed iOS/Android release builds and physical camera/files/network/session/background acceptance are not complete. Site update does not update packaged APK resources.
mvpOpen.exitCriterion: Client and worker builds signed, installed and accepted on Android/iOS with the latest resources.

mvpOpen.finding: APNs/FCM device registry and delivery are absent in the inspected API/contracts/mobile scripts. Specification requires notifications but does not name APNs/FCM literally; delivery expectations for a closed application must be agreed.
mvpOpen.exitCriterion: Agreed mobile delivery transport works with registration/revocation, permissions, foreground/background/closed-app cases and authorized navigation.

mvpOpen.finding: Teams/routes are editable, but statuses and default SLA values remain constants; no administrative SLA/escalation editor.
mvpOpen.exitCriterion: Agreed rule configuration and escalation work with audit while preserving server workflow invariants.

mvpOpen.finding: Applying a newer imported meter version explicitly sets responsibleId to null and overwrites a site-managed worker assignment. The current DEMO worker has no assigned meter, so worker reading submission is not ready for demonstration. Tenant submission followed by engineer review is a separate route; unchanged repeated versions are skipped.
mvpOpen.exitCriterion: Preserve the existing operational assignment when applying a newer imported meter version; allow creation without assignment. Pass a targeted merge test, narrow worker authorization checks and a real repeat import before demonstrating this worker route.

mvpOpen.finding: Documents link to equipment and task/ticket, but maintenance_plan is not a supported document entity. Whether documents must version the regulation itself needs confirmation.
mvpOpen.exitCriterion: Customer accepts equipment/task linkage or explicit maintenance-plan/version linkage is implemented.

externalAcceptanceOpen.finding: Specific configurations/versions, two real independent sources, service rights/license, server cluster, current bidirectional delivery and durable schedule require actual deployment acceptance. File/Srvr parameters do not prove universal compatibility.

Acts.bsl:43 saves a draft using Doc.Write(); PostDemoAct creates a separate marked manual ledger movement. Normal sales/VAT posting is not proven and is not an unconditional literal MVP requirement; agree the desired accounting result.
Real agreed phone/channel login and delivery must be accepted; passwords or admin-issued sessions do not prove OTP delivery.
CSV/XLSX mechanism is implemented; actual customer file and unambiguous matching must be accepted.
Contract/account rules, owner/tenant rights, source ownership, meter master, approvers, tariffs, SLA and optional EDI/payment integrations remain customer decisions.
A controlled demo is not evidence of a completed customer pilot and industrial acceptance.

nextStageOpen.finding: Estimates and work-log amounts exist; full cost calculation and deep commercial calculations do not.
Hours/work logs do not implement payroll distribution.
Material catalog/estimate lines are not stock balances, batches, reservations, movements or accounting write-offs.
Manual validated readings are not automated meter telemetry.
DXF/layers/optimistic versioning exist; a full historical archive and restoration of replanning geometry do not.
Dashboard/NOI/forecast are not a full agreed BI/P&L model.
Manual payment/proof and 1C payment display are not acquiring/bank payment integrations.
No unified inspection/defect/reinspection/handover-act/key-transfer process. Service act is not handover act.

claimsNotSupported: All specification and industrial acceptance completed

Saved service act equals normal sales document and VAT posting
Emulated mobile browser equals physical Android/iOS/push acceptance
Published web automatically updates old packaged APKs
Basic financial dashboard equals completed full P&L or inventory accounting
Imported meter worker assignment remains durable across newer 1C versions without the responsibleId fix and repeat-import acceptance
